decisions.reason: ACE3 was publicly launched as the firm's new industry-standard ALCMS control solution, core to its airfield direction and backed by substantial R&D, so any early weakness would be read as temporary and dropping it would write off a visible commitment.

The air situation display extends the firm's established tower offer and fits its integrated-operations strategy, and only one year after launch no evidence suggests failure, so the investment and strategic fit favour keeping it despite less public emphasis.
